## Summary

Describe the user-visible or maintenance change and the reason for it.

## Validation

- [ ] Ran `node --check script.js`.
- [ ] Tested the affected flow in a current browser.
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation.

## Review notes

- [ ] This change has no breaking behavior, or the breaking behavior is described above.
- [ ] This change has no security or privacy impact, or the impact is described above.
- [ ] This pull request does not include credentials, personal data, or generated browser-storage exports.
